decisions: Use UUIDs for tenant and externally referenced aggregate roots; allow explicit bigint exceptions only for justified high-volume internal detail rows; preserve upstream bigint designs for Solid databases; enforce a conservative aggregate connection budget at boot
risks: The aggregate capacity formula is intentionally conservative when role URLs use separate clusters; operators must capacity-plan each managed cluster. Initial focused tests exposed four expectation/test-double issues and were corrected before the passing full suite. An initial unnamespaced multi-DB rollback command failed; the correct primary-namespaced down/up tasks passed.
